description: This file defines an interface for creating server request objects within the PSR (PHP Standards Recommendation) HTTP message interface package. It declares a method for constructing server request instances, specifying parameters like HTTP method, URI, and server parameters.

classes.name: ServerRequestFactoryInterface
classes.description: An interface defining the factory method for creating server request instances.

methods.name: createServerRequest
methods.description: Creates a new server request object with specified HTTP method, URI, and server parameters.
